thread:
elaine: Heads-up — external pen test scheduled Tue 10:00am PT (assessors: RedHelm). We need an RBAC snapshot, KMS access plan, audit-log harvest, and a clear remediation + retest checklist. Who can take which pieces? :eyes:
sam: I can own RBAC snapshot + vuln triage tracking. Need list of resources in-scope and exact service accounts to include.
kevin: I’ll own KMS ephemeral roles and key-binding changes. Quick Q: do they need KMS Decrypt only, or some sign/verify? @anita any compliance constraints?
anita: Decrypt-only for artifact verification is fine. Keep retention to 90 days by default; we can extend if assessor requests long-term evidence. Also need an evidence acceptance form signed.
sam: For the RBAC snapshot I'll run the exporter and land artefacts in the evidence bucket tagged with the thread ts. Example commands I plan to run:

```
./rbac-export --scope=prod,staging --format=json > rbac-6800122334.json
gsutil cp rbac-6800122334.json gs://redwood-pt-evidence/6800122334/
```

kevin: KMS plan: create ephemeral role `kms-pt-assessor` with only `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` on the artifact key. Will add time-bound IAM binding and audit it. Need oncall/approval window.
ops-bot: Temporary role request created: PT-6800122334. Approvers: @ryan, @kevin. Request link: https://rbw.ops/requests/6800122334 :white_check_mark:
ryan: I can review/approve at 9:30am PT day-of. Also we must snapshot Cloud Audit Logs and set an immutability/retention policy on the evidence bucket before testers start. Suggest daily export + immediate pre-engagement snapshot.
sam: Also flagging telemetry gaps: model-hosting traces currently omit token-level request IDs. We probably cannot enable token capture (PII), but we should at minimum capture request_id + latency + route for 72h. That will help repro and triage.
kevin: We can inject a short-lived ingress middleware that logs `{request_id, route, latency_ms}` to BigQuery for 48h. Will include a rollback PR to remove middleware after window.
anita: Ensure logs are redacted; remove any user-provided prompt text or embeddings. Evidence must include checksum + manifest file listing all items.
sam: I'll spin up the remediation tracker board and populate with vuln buckets + owners. Proposed retest slots: Wed-Fri the week after (two 2-hour windows per day). Anyone object?
ryan: +1. Also add a regression abort condition: if auth failures or 5xx increase >3x vs baseline during retest, abort and notify stakeholders.
sam: Will add alert rule and rollback playbook to the runbook.
kevin: ACK — I’ll post the PR with ephemeral role, policy snippet, and a testing checklist. Snippet in the PR will look like:

```yaml
bindings:
  - role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
    members:
      - serviceAccount:kms-pt-assessor@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    condition:
      title: "PT ephemeral binding"
      expression: "request.time > timestamp('2026-04-01T16:00:00Z') && request.time < timestamp('2026-04-01T18:00:00Z')"
```

anita: ACK — legal OK for the timing and retention. I’ll prepare the evidence acceptance form template and handover checklist.
ryan: ACK — I’ll enable the audit export job and set bucket immutability policy at least 1 hour before engagement start. I’ll post the export command in the PR.
elaine: Thanks all. I’ll schedule a 30-min dry-run Thu 11:00am PT to rehearse evidence collection and the KMS role lifecycle. Calendar invite to follow. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Invite posted to #eng-security and added attendees: elaine, sam, kevin, ryan, anita. Reminder 15m before.
elaine: One last ask — please drop any pre-engagement notes (privileged accounts, special targets, whitelist IPs) into the thread before EOD Friday so I can consolidate the runbook.
sam: Dropping items now: 1) service-account list (will attach), 2) temp tracer config, 3) initial vuln buckets.
kevin: I’ll link the PR once created.
ryan: I’ll post the audit export logs and checksum validation steps once run.
elaine: Great. Closing loop — if anyone needs escalation channel during the test use #release-war-room and tag me.
